Prophecy: Other Sheep Shall Be Brought into One Flock under One Shepherd
ProphecySummary: Jesus predicts that he has other sheep not of this fold, that he must bring them also, that they shall hear his voice, and that there shall be one flock and one shepherd.
Fulfillment: Partially fulfilled: Gentile believers have been brought into the one flock under Christ, while the gathering of all his sheep is still ongoing.
